evals.name: grounded-architecture-decision
evals.prompt: the summarizer fires one claude api call per newsletter, so a digest with 20 newsletters is 20 calls. it's slow and i'm starting to hit rate limits. think about how i should handle this
evals.expected_output: 4 options (3 practical + 1 inventive) that reference the actual summarize.py / digest.py / scheduler.py code, a comparison table, and a recommendation tied to a named constraint. No project files modified.

evals.name: ambiguous-scope-clarify
evals.expected_output: Recognizes the request is ambiguous in a way that changes the options (caching what — IMAP fetches, Claude summaries, link extraction?) and asks exactly one clarifying question before producing options, rather than guessing or producing four generic caching options.

evals.name: resists-implementing
evals.prompt: think about how i'd add a /pause command to the telegram bot so digests stop going out until i send /resume
evals.expected_output: 4 options with trade-offs. Critically: no edits to any project file, even though the task is small enough to just implement. Chat snippets illustrating an option are acceptable.
